# Ellen Brock Editing

> A comprehensive resource hub for novel writers and editors featuring video tutorials, craft instruction, and professional editing guidance from experienced freelance editor Ellen Brock.

Ellen Brock is a freelance editor with 13 years of professional experience who shares writing craft knowledge through her YouTube channel, Patreon community, and extensive blog archive. The site combines structured writing instruction (Novel Boot Camp series), first-page critiques, character and story development guides, and fiction excerpts demonstrating craft principles.

## Key Topics

- Novel Writing
- Character Development
- Story Structure
- First Page Critique
- Novel Boot Camp
- Writing Craft

## Core Resources

- [Ellen Brock – Novel Editor | YouTuber](https://ellenbrockediting.com): Homepage with novel writing resources, plotting guides, and editor advice.
- [About Me – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/about-me): Professional background of Ellen Brock, freelance editor with 13 years experience.

## Novel Writing Essentials

- [Novel Writing Essentials – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/novel-writing-essentials): Essential video tutorials on story structure, character arcs, and editing craft.
- [Videos and Other Resources – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/videos-and-other-resources): Comprehensive resource collection for novel writing and editing guidance.
- [Two Ways to Structure Your Novel's Opening – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/2018/07/30/two-ways-to-structure-your-novels-opening): Video guide on novel opening structure and inciting incident placement strategies.

## Novel Boot Camp Series

- [Novel Boot Camp – Lecture #1: The First Page Promise – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/2014/07/01/novel-boot-camp-lecture-1-the-first-page-promise): First lecture on novel openings and first page craft for aspiring writers.
- [Novel Boot Camp – Lecture #14: Strengthening the Setting – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/2014/07/23/novel-boot-camp-lecture-14-strengthening-the-setting): Writing instruction on developing compelling story settings and world-building.
- [How to Edit Your Novel's Characters [Novel Boot Camp 18] – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/2017/08/30/how-to-edit-your-novels-characters-novel-boot-camp-18): Character editing guide covering arcs, traits, and strengthening character development.
- [Novel Boot Camp – Wrap Up & Contest Winners – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/2014/08/01/novel-boot-camp-wrap-up-contest-winners): Novel Boot Camp completion announcement with contest winner results.

## First Page Critiques & Analysis

- [First Page Critiques: Young Adult [Novel Boot Camp] – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/2017/08/11/first-page-critiques-young-adult-novel-boot-camp): First page analysis and manuscript feedback for young adult novel openings.
- [10 First Page Critiques: Scifi, Fantasy, Horror Edition [Novel Boot Camp] – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/2017/08/04/10-first-page-critiques-scifi-fantasy-horror-edition-novel-boot-camp): First page critiques and publishability assessment for speculative fiction.

## Editing & Publishing Guidance

- [Should I Hire a Freelance Editor For My Novel? – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/2014/03/06/should-i-hire-a-freelance-editor-for-my-novel): Guidance on hiring freelance editors and novel editing services.
- [Patreon Podcast Topics – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/8630-2): Patreon-exclusive podcast episodes on writing craft and character development.

## Fiction Excerpts & Examples

- [Not Decided – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/not-decided): Fiction excerpt featuring Daphne Valentine in paranormal mystery setting.
- [The English Rider – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/the-english-rider): Steampunk fiction excerpt with Lady Penelope Prescott and automaton engineering.
- [The Inquisitor's Compass – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/the-inquisitors-compass): Fantasy fiction excerpt featuring magical academy and inquisitor training.
- [Man Wanted – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/man-wanted-2): Romantic comedy fiction excerpt with dialogue and character development example.
- [Schism – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/schism): Historical fiction excerpt featuring assassination plot in ancient Rome.
- [Untitled YA Thriller – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/untitled-ya-thriller): YA thriller fiction excerpt featuring protagonist Bendigo with supernatural elements.
- [From Heels to Sandals – Ellen Brock](https://ellenbrockediting.com/from-heels-to-sandals): Creative fiction excerpt about career change and life transition.
